segments.text: Welcome to the product sync for the Orbit mobile app.
The launch of the Orbit mobile app is delayed to November 15 because of the payments integration.
We decided to build the app with Flutter so one team can ship both Android and iOS.
The approved budget for the mobile launch is 40 lakh rupees.
Kavya will run the beta test with 200 users starting next Monday.
We still need to decide whether the app will support offline mode at launch.
